_comment: Neutral agent name -> platform model + reasoning effort. CC takes one alias (haiku=Haiku 4.5, sonnet=Sonnet 5). GHCP takes an ordered fallback list: names get retired, so the first one available to the account wins; keep a cross-vendor fallback. effort -> CC `effort`, GHCP `reasoning-effort` (low | medium | high | xhigh | max; a level the model lacks is ignored).
